verdict.rationale: First-party docs show `$skill-installer` installing individual curated skills by name from the openai/skills collection (e.g. `$skill-installer linear`, `gh-address-comments`) or by a specific GitHub directory URL, so a developer picks single skills rather than the whole collection. A recorded hands-on probe also installed just one skill (`--skill plugin-creator`) from the openai/plugins catalog, but it used third-party tooling, so it corroborates selective installation without exercising the product's own installer. Missing for 10: any documented way to pick a subset of skills inside a bundled plugin (plugins install as a unit), and hands-on corroboration of `$skill-installer` itself.
